title: One rectangle — the card the app already has
question: You are right, and more than you may have meant: the app ALREADY builds this. renderHomeToday() draws one .td-card with היום, the date, a progress bar with a dot at the current minute, the schedule, and what you said not to forget. I had been inventing a replacement for something that exists. This is that card wearing our material - same structure, same class names, same content - so porting it is a stylesheet and not a rewrite.

options.label: The day, one rectangle
options.thesis: The ground raised into one panel. The progress bar became a channel pressed into it, amber up to now with the lit dot exactly at the minute. The divider between the two columns is light instead of a rule, and the only other colour is the per-task dot - the one place colour says WHICH rather than WHEN.
options.viewport: The fan, then one card: הלוז on one side, לזכור on the other.
options.risk: Two real notes: לזכור is the wider column but carries less, so it reads emptier than the schedule; and the past rows use opacity, which in this material makes them look faded rather than finished - pressing them in would say it better.
